notes.title: 🌊 Sombionic Summer Event
notes.content:
[p]This event comes once a year during Summer and features a limited time skin! Alongside the seasonal content, the update also brings a set of fresh gameplay changes, check out what’s new below:[/p][p][/p][p][b]📌Highlights:[/b][/p][p]•Summer Event + exclusive skin
•3 new animations
•Climax system
•Audio added to animation scenes
•New underwear category with Bra + Panties set
•Accessories: 3 bracelets, 1 necklace
•Cinematic camera mode[/p][p][/p][p][i]Details below:[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]•Summer Event:[/b] A limited-time seasonal event featuring a new skin.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/6b0a30b1657761dfd70d8a5c4d2f4fd1b3474147.png"][/img][/p][p][b]•3 New Animations:[/b] Added three new scenes featuring [b]Melany x FBL-Ø (Flesh-Binding Larva: Origin)[/b]. One of these includes the very first [b]climax and post-climax sequence.[/b][/p][p][b]•Climax System:[/b] This new system allows any character in Sombionic to reach a [b]climactic state[/b] during certain animations or scenes. Once the character reaches their [b]climax threshold[/b], the player has an option to transition to a special animation, which contains “Climax” and “After-Climax (resting)” animations.[/p][p][b]•Cinematic Camera + Saved Angles:[/b] Animation scenes now default to a cinematic camera that automatically switches between multiple angles, creating a movie-like experience[/p][p][b]•Save Camera:[/b] Players can now pick and save their preferred camera angle: cinematic, fixed angle or fly, then it will automatically be loaded in future animation scenes.[/p][p][b]•Bikini Shop + Equipment: [/b]A new bikini category has been introduced to the store and inventory. The first models include matching bra and panties.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/d4a448c927ef95fe9bdcc472e3451c043523f5b4.png"][/img][/p][p]•[b]Multi-Purpose Slots (Mirror Items)[/b]: Items that can be worn on multiple sides of the body, such as bracelets or rings, now use shared slots. The system automatically assigns the equipped item to the correct hand or side (e.g., left or right wrist).[/p][p][b]•Shop Clutter Removed:[/b] Mirror or opposite items are no longer displayed as duplicates in the shop. Instead of listing every individual variation (e.g., all ten finger rings), a single entry now represents all possible variants, which can then be equipped into any available slot. This reduces unnecessary clutter.[/p][p]•[b]Underwear Shop + Equipment[/b]: A dedicated underwear category has been added to the inventory, complete with its own equipment slots. The first items include bras and thongs, with additional pieces like socks planned for future updates.[/p][p]•[b]Item Overlap System[/b]: Equipped items now dynamically conceal smaller items beneath them. For example, larger gear like boots will automatically hide socks when worn together.[/p][p][b]•Liquids (Experimental): [/b]An early implementation of liquid effects during animation scenes.[/p][p][b]•Dynamic Foot Adjustment:[/b] The character’s feet now automatically raise or lower depending on the type of shoes equipped.[/p][p][b]•Combat and Background Music:[/b] High-energy punk tracks now play dynamically during combat, while horror-themed ambient music sets the mood outside of battle.[/p][p][b]•Audio Control[/b]: Expanded audio settings with new adjustable categories, including Ambience, Combat, Animation Scene Music, Female/Male Voice, Female/Male Animation Voice, Combat SFX, Romance SFX, Environment SFX, Living SFX, Common SFX, and UI SFX.[/p][p][b]•Clothing State: [/b]Certain clothes are unequipped during the scene and once the scene ends they are automatically equipped again.[/p][p][b]•Decals Projector:[/b] A system for projecting textures onto objects like for example the logo displayed on the back of the new Lifejacket item.[/p][p][b]•Boss War UI:[/b] Better UI for Boss War game mode.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/d880886141ac95e5d003e421e27e3bfbe85d4a3a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]•Shader Cutout Fix (Unity Update):[/b] The cutout shader has been updated for the new Unity version. This shader is used to hide body parts underneath clothing, ensuring that skin no longer clips through equipped outfits.[/p][p][b]•Localization Update: [/b]The animation scenes UI and customization UI are now integrated with the localization system. Currently, only English is supported, but adding additional languages is now much easier. [/p]

notes.title: Climax System
notes.content: [p][i]NOTE: Sombionic remains a SFW game, that will support a free DLC that unlocks extra content![/i][/p][p][/p][p]The Climax System allows any character in Sombionic to reach a climactic state during certain animations or scenes. Once the character reaches their climax threshold, the player has an option to transition to a special animation, which contains “Climax” and “After-Climax (resting)” animations. Then go back to the other animations as normally. Special mini games will be introduced in the future for the climax animations, for example to press the button during a certain time and cause more intense climax.[/p][p]This system is directly to multiple layers of the gameplay system:[/p][list][*][p][b]Visual Feedback[/b]: VFX systems are activated based on preset particle keys and specific pivots on the body model. Those VFXs are basically trails of fluids.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio Events[/b]: Sound effects are triggered to provide organic sounds tied to the character’s climax style.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Decals (Experimental):[/b] When the fluids land on the character, they will leave decals (for example on the face / torso etc..).[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/a0b467e3148a959df861a09168c4672bdb981ac8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/df276ad1564e2d27581153350937f18ec64ccb21.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Game Consequences[/b]: Climaxing results in the release of semen, which is then used for downstream systems like fertility checks, pregnancy logic and so on depending on where the semen is released.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Animations (To be added): [/b]Those will be tiny (layered) animations triggered during climax. These include actions like mouth opening, eye closing or a head tilt backward for a short period of time.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Heat System (Cooldown)[/b][/p][p]The Climax system needed a way to prevent players from spamming the button while still making the gameplay feel satisfying. Just using static cooldowns felt too rigid after a few days of testing, because the goal is to allow players to climax 3-4 times quickly and then have the cooldown gradually increase the more they use it.[/p][list][*][p]Each press now generates Heat. The higher your Heat, the longer the cooldown becomes.[/p][/*][*][p]Heat decays over time, especially if you stop pressing after about 6 seconds of inactivity, it fully resets.[/p][/*][*][p]The cooldown scaling is non-linear, so early presses feel fast (0.25s, 0.65s, 1s), but it ramps up with abuse (2s, 4s, 8s, up to a ~20s max). After testing, those values might be balanced.[/p][/*][*][p]There’s also a small random chance a press won’t increase Heat at all, which adds unpredictability and lets you sometimes squeeze in extra uses.[/p][/*][*][p]You can’t spam, but you’re rewarded for timing and restraint.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Stats[/b][/p][p]Once a player enters a Climax Animation Scene, a new dedicated UI will appear just below the existing animation controls. This new interface is specifically designed for managing climax.[/p][p]Each character involved in the scene will have their own Climax Button, allowing players to trigger their finishers individually.[/p][p]In addition to the buttons, the UI will display important climax-related stats, such as:[/p][list][*][p][b]Seed Amount:[/b] how much was produced during the climax.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Seed Quality:[/b] a value representing potency, consistency, or purity (depending on context).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Jewelry System: Collars, Rings and more!
notes.content:
Jewelry items will be separate from skins (where "skin" refers to a full outfit). These items will be available for purchase more frequently through the in-game store using in-game currency, as they require less time to model and add to the inventory. 

Jewelry can be equipped alongside any skin, offering expanded customization options without restriction. 

The following is the current list of supported jewelry categories, listed from top to bottom:
Hat, Glasses, Earrings, Necklace, Upper Arm (Left/Right) Wristband (Left/Right), Rings (10 slots per hand), Thigh (Left/Right), Ankle (Left/Right).
The categories currently in development and planned for inclusion in the next update are:

[b]Collars / Necklaces[/b]
Includes a variety of designs, ranging from chokers to goth-style collars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/34f30000cb140e009c1993c75b4eacdb0f82e99a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/ace3f187b75064d108046951a7335aa0b16d9ffd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/d8c6a9667a74941b64d2dda6aca2c6289c3b54a7.png[/img]
[b]Rings[/b]
Rings can be equipped on each individual finger. Equipping the same ring on all fingers requires purchasing 10 copies, mirroring real-world behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/bedc616f2796de589f2b291b62e09107324d7e13.png[/img]
[b]Earrings[/b]
One earring can be equipped per ear. Additional earring slots may be considered for future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/f5fff54414405eda17ea01c2d4faf8188f5c89f9.png[/img]
[b]Wristbands[/b]
Wristbands are equipped individually on the left and right wrists, allowing for varied combinations and styles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/8c64dcccc22de1190f3eb6e22f090fadea891f34.png[/img]
Feedback regarding additional jewelry types is welcome. Suggestions may influence future content updates.

notes.title: 🐰 The Easter Event
notes.content:
The Easter Event will give you the Easter BNY-1 skin, and you can customize its colors and other material properties! 

Check it out below:

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/sxNxT2h1/output.gif[/img]

In-game:

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wzbq9KYY/output.gif[/img]

What are the other things that this event build brings? Let’s explore them!

•[b]3D Echo System[/b]: A new "Echoes" system has been introduced to enhance the visual feedback of in-game animations. When characters perform actions that produce sound such as impacts, explosions, or footsteps - corresponding onomatopoeic text like "PLAPS" or "BOOM" is now displayed in 3D space.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bdcvRKgZ/output.gif[/img]

•[b]New organ: Liver[/b]: A new organ - the Liver has been introduced. When health drops to  critical (currently at 15 HP), the Liver has a chance to trigger an instant regeneration effect based on its tier:
      •[b]Tier 2[/b] – Strain Liver
      Restores 60% of maximum health
      Chance: 100%
      Cooldown: 15 seconds
      •[b]Tier 3[/b] – Non-Human Primate 44
      Restores 100% of maximum health
      Chance: 100%
      Cooldown: 10 seconds
This organ provides a powerful reactive boost, giving players a second wind when facing near-death situations.

•[b]Item stats[/b]: A long-requested feature has now been implemented. Item attributes are now displayed directly when hovering over them. Players can view precise statistics such as numerical values, descriptive text, or other effects in a clear and consistent manner. The system has been built with full localization support.
Previously, items like the Heart would only show vague descriptions such as "Gives a moderate boost to max HP," requiring players to estimate the actual benefit. This update eliminates the need for guesswork by showing exact values. Items with more complex effects, such as the Lungs or Adrenal Gland, now provide significantly clearer information about their impact. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/48ee45f11a9c3338c2bf63425d0f365b58c6a8af.png[/img]

•[b]Icons for empty equipment[/b]: When no items are equipped, all the equipment slot icons are visible (but grayed out), so that it is easy to identify which item belongs to each equipment slot.

[b]Transparency Customization[/b]: You can now adjust the transparency of select items such as the bunny suit, scientist top, and glasses. This feature is limited to specific items and won’t apply universally.

•[b]Inventory backward compatibility[/b]: The inventory system now supports loading older saves, allowing for retroactive customization updates to previously existing items if needed.

•[b]Shops improvements[/b]: More items added in the Store under Organs section and added support for unlimited items in the shop.

•[b]Supporter notifications[/b]: After placing the required text file in the game's data folder to unlock tier rewards - Genehunter, Bioweapon, and Immunity - a confirmation popup will appear before the splash screen. This message will confirm that the rewards have been successfully unlocked and provide instructions on how to claim them in-game.

•[b]Supporter rewards[/b]: More organ rewards added for tiers: Genehunter, Bioweapon and Immunity

•[b]Unity 2022 update progress[/b]: A new branch of the project has been created to fix all bugs related to the the unity 2022 upgrade and finally it’s been closed meaning all issues are fixed and the main project is ready for an update in the near future.

notes.title: Solo scenes & companions
notes.content:
[b]Solo animation scenes
[/b]Heart symbols scattered across the map can now be interacted with to start a solo animation scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/344bd3d4180a538aaa6c3d5e9d00f64b07187832.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/0e098e484dfcf402f86c8b0499e611e0d9e225b7.png[/img]

These will mostly be solo fun / Roleplay and will have dialogue that drives the scene forward and a little bit different UI (for example abilities won’t be present).

[b]Companion from the (optional) pregnancy feature
[/b]
It took me a while to create companions that inherit traits from their fathers, such as colors and attack types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/fa6d85b9495375e2d29dae0eaff720c6c86b526f.png[/img]

Right now, this is the only available companion, but adding more should be easy now that the base system is in place. It comes with attack animations, sounds, and AI that allows it to chase and attack targets. Each attack consumes 5% of its life.

Since this is an optional mechanic and the game is a TPS, I’ve decided not to have companions follow the player. This would require too much work and could lead to them getting stuck on ledges due to the terrain. Instead, companions will roam freely and only engage in combat when enemies are nearby. If you move too far away, they will disappear, but you can respawn them at any time.

I also developed a save system to manage all of this, including pregnancy stats such as:
[list]
[*]     Seed inside, along with its properties like lifespan.
[*]     Ovum count, determining how many can be fertilized.
[*]     Fetus development, tracking its growth into a creature.
[*]     Spawnable creatures, which can be summoned when ready.
[/list]
Additionally, I reworked the animation scene UI, now featuring a kink tab, accessible by clicking the devil heart icon.

[b]Climax System (Experimental)
[/b]
An experimental system that triggers intense in-game animations, currently could be seen during animations with pregnancy feature enabled. A bar fills from 0% to 100%, and once it reaches 100%, climax animations can be triggered. Afterward, the system enters a short cooldown before it can be activated again.

[b]Loot[/b]

Introduced different types of loot that can spawn across the map. Some loot can only be collected once, while others can be looted multiple times when replaying the same slot.

notes.title: (Optional) Pregnancy and X-Ray
notes.content:
These two mechanics will be entirely optional and come with a FREE (NSFW) DLC, with no presence in the story - no dialogues, no quests. To access them, players must enable them in the settings; otherwise, they will remain unseen. That said, both systems are designed with depth and complexity for those who enjoy them. They are not just features to check off but carefully crafted mechanics shaped by deliberate design choices.

Additional optional mechanics will be introduced, provided they align with the Biopunk genre, just as these do.

[b]X-RAY[/b]

This shows the internal view of the characters during animation scenes, I’ve decided to go with a 2D approach as it can be drawn and animated separately. This will take 25% of the canvas and be shown on the right side of the screen.

[b]Repetitive Pregnancy System (Parasitic)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/a146b2f076435ac26c30a0b837b7ceb6c60bede0.png[/img]

Once you turn on this feature…

1) Your character experiences a reproductive cycle, generating a new ovum every few minutes.

2) During animation scenes, you will have the option to trigger a pregnancy mechanic. The amount of liquid released is measured in milliliters (see the stats window below), and an available ovum is required for the process to be successful, of course you can release the liquid and then wait for it to be available, but you are wasting valuable time.

3) The seed remains viable for a few minutes, and at regular intervals, it will attempt to fertilize an available ovum. If successful…

4) A fertilized egg is formed, initiating the growth of a fetus that develops to a specific size based on the type of creature it will become. This process triggers visual changes in the character, such as belly expansion, along with potential buffs or debuffs (e.g., reduced jump height, to be implemented later).

Keep in mind, your character has a "fetus" capacity of 18, which can be increased with certain items. This allows multiple fetuses to develop simultaneously.

5) Once a fetus fully matures, you can spawn a creature to fight alongside you for a limited time. During the seed’s viable lifespan of a few minutes, it will continue attempting to trigger fertilization.

6) If you wish to clear the liquid inside, you can use a specific tonic item or visit a designated location for cleansing.

Again, these mechanics are optional and will not influence your progression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/2994d22efdb606700a5b57a18eb31044766b9ad3.png[/img]

 A few other things that are tied…

[b]Notifications
[/b]
I’ve finally made a system to display notifications for a limited time at different parts of the screen. The systems above show notifications, which you can turn on / off from the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/7ac026b4ab2fed04c3b959296c245d6d70e5b5e9.png[/img]

[b]Settings[/b]

Saving your settings will display “You have unsaved changes” message.

[b]Engine update
[/b]
This is a preparation for a bigger update, finally on the latest version of this one, which allowed me to update navigation and audio systems for better features and performance.

[b]Checkpoints[/b]

Added more checkpoints, so you don't have to restart the level if you die.

[/list]

notes.title: Boss War: New Game Mode!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/523942e202a9f348ca35ad8e2a2c23d004017ab4.png[/img]

Get ready, Somas!

Introducing BOSS WAR, a new game mode, now live in Sombionic! The rules are simple:

1. Take down the yellow boss to claim a powerful buff!

2. Defeat the enemy boss before time runs out and protect your own boss at all costs!

The battle never ends—respawn and dive back into action across multiple rounds! Take down mutants, earn exclusive loot, and stack up your currency.

At its core, this game mode has two teams battling against each other, each having its own boss. The team that defeats the enemy boss first wins the round. To stand a chance, you must first take down the yellow buff to boost your damage—otherwise, you'll barely scratch the enemy boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/101d29a3c85c008b68818a76bd067977aba2df68.png[/img]
[i]Figure 1.0: Showing the yellow buff that drops after the buff is defeated.
[/i]
This buff is temporary, so hurry to the enemy base and take down their boss while it lasts!

The main purpose of this game mode is to dive straight into combat with respawn turned on, farm items, currencies and achievements while having fun with the enemies. There won’t be any story or dialogues just what you’d expect from a Deathmatch mode, but with the bosses twist.

I’m working on one map for the next build, but I’ve planned two more while the idea is that they are going to be using similar models to the levels you go through while playing the Campaign (otherwise the game will get huge). However, the level design, post processing and lighting will vary and won’t be the same as the Campaign and if the map size is large, there might be 3 teams facing each other.

The next release including this mode hopefully won’t take me more than 2 weeks, if things go right. It will be the v0.1 of Boss War and I’d be looking for your feedback on how to improve that mode, again t    his won’t be the final version and more enemies will come as I add them into the game.

[*]More is to come such as changing textures and resizing different parts of their bodies.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/8731768e14410f8be7a6c01425bc25e115baea59.png[/img]
[i]Figure 1.0: Showing character customization during animation scene.[/i]

Currently this feature is available to members of the Genehunter, Biowepaon and Immunity tiers.

[b]Targeting[/b]

Melany has 7 target points around her that enemies can follow while attacking. This is done, so you won't see enemies with melee weapons clipping into each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/ef80f87ede1cb942f696a40deed6bd94b88b6e86.png[/img]
[i]Figure 2.0: An arc of target points around Melany[/i]

The problem is with the side target points especially the ones on the left and while some of you were playing the game and recording a video, I noticed it's extremely hard to hit an enemy that has picked target point on the left. 
The picking process was random even if you have 1 enemy, it could attack you from the side, which makes no sense, because the points in front would be much better option at least visually. 
Therefore, I reworked this whole system today and introduced a priority for each follow point, the ones in the front are with higher priority, but as enemies take them, the priority drops, so the more enemies that chase you, the bigger the chance one will pick a side follow point, but that usually happens with > 6 enemies, which at that point is not a problem. I did one trick where long-ranged enemies will always try to pick the side follow points, so the ones in the front are left empty for melee characters. 
Finally, as you kill enemies in the front and they free up space, the ones on the side will automatically change their current follow point to one of those in front.

[b]Read dialogues at your own pace[/b]

A very requested feature was recently added – being able to read the dialogues at your own pace while having a “Continue Button” that you have to press to progress the dialogue. This can be turned on/off from the Accessibility settings (ESC / Settings / Accessibility / Show Continue Button In Dialogues), which is on by default.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/57c2c58b814a11747986b58101940ad0fccf357c.png[/img]
[i]Figure 3.0: A continue button on the right side of the dialogue that you have to press to continue.
[/i]
[b]Spawn objects during NSFW animations
[/b]
Now, during certain animations it’s possible to spawn props to help the characters be in that pose, such as a sofa, bed, chair etc.

[b]Medkits[/b]

Those, who have played the last build might have noticed that certain mutants drop medkits or they are available at different points of the terrain during combat. Since then, I’ve greatly improved their design to be more recognizable.
Medkits may have different tiers (T1, T2, T3.. TN), with different designs and amount of healing. Depending on the zone/game mode/difficulty a buff may be applied to the medkit to give different amounts of health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/6a2c4ef79d03dcc724df548bc973a17dc3548dea.png[/img]
[i]Figure 4.0: A medkit that will heal the player when you go through.
[/i]
Those medkids will instantly heal you with 20-50 health (will vary depending on the combat zone) as soon as you go through them.

[b]Check Points[/b]

When loading a saved game from the main menu, the system will automatically find and load the most recent checkpoint.

notes.title: The v0.2 demo, Compass, Fly Camera and more! (DEVLOG)
notes.content:
Just before the release of the v0.2 demo, I added a highly requested feature since a lot of people were asking me about a compass and at first I was against it because of the mainly linear environments, but in some places we have caves and it might not be clear where you are supposed to go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/94ddc82089e9479740abc670099fa15de06007d5.png[/img]

Instead of an actual compass, I added “Points of Interest” – it shows the target’s location and the remaining distance. There’s also an option to change the icon based on the target, but for now the icon will be the one you see above.

Points of Interest spawn on every quest and every task after the tutorial (since it’s very linear and there’s no point to add them there).
[b]
Fly Camera[/b]

Another extremely highly requested feature and something that was on my To-Do list for a long time was a Fly Camera during romance animations, you can explore them from any angle and distance you wish. It also has a seamless transition from and to your current static camera.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/f64e594717847bb0362cb14d79b8c69804f32671.gif[/img]

After this, the only major camera view during romance animations I might consider is POV. Using the Fly Camera, you can definitely position it in that way, but if the head of the character is moving too much, it will clip into the view, therefore a POV camera must be attached to the character’s head or follow the head movements, again this won’t be a priority for now.

Another possibility is a “camera” that automatically switches between the static angles and has a small motion kind of like a cinematic view, this isn’t really a new camera type just a fancy controller that makes use of the existing static camera.

Right after a release, I spend a week focusing on smaller tasks that don’t demand much cognitive energy and this time by request I’m working on accessibility features – being able to make the UI bigger, so people with difficulties can see it better. I believe when selling a game on Steam, developers should be focusing on such things that won’t really be a priority if you are doing a game jam. Those are all kinds of accessibility settings, control rebinding, being able to revert the mouse Y (to support those who are used to playing on a controller), translation and much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/8fe5fb3a57fd7c82746d01f086238f50fcd1fc48.png[/img]

Now, I’m going to post the whole changelog for v0.2 and a week-by-week breakdown of what I’ve been working on.

🌟Highlights:
[list]
[*] New H-Scene
[*] Enemies can romance you during combat [READ MORE]
[*] Customize your character’s equipment – equip and unequip individual items. [READ MORE]
[*] New character type – Mutant
[*] New character type – Slime
[*] Navigation System – Compass Points of Interest.
[/list]

And much more…

Week 1:
[list]
[*] Skippable prologue (while playing it and from the menu).
[*] Checkpoints are now working correctly.
[*] Hold ‘E’ is converted to just Press ‘E’ in most of the cases, where it’s still hold, you will see a UI popup letting you know you should hold.
[*] The shooting range tutorial has only 1 task, which is a combination of the static & dynamic targets.
[*] The shooting targets count for the tutorial is reduced from 30 to 10 (but its repeatable if you wish).
[*] Enemy difficulty is toned down during the first level.
[*] If you break the collision in the cave level you won't fall down, but be teleported inside the cave again.
[*] Saving your progress after the level has been completed is fully working.
[*] Fixed full screen and windowed mode not switching.
[*] Small localization errors were fixed.
[*] Fixed small bugs in the UI.
[/list]

Week 2 + 3:
[list]
[*] A new AI that stays in place and attacks – it will be used for tentacles and tanky characters that are optional to kill, but drop a decent loot.
[*] A new AI with low health, low movement speed, and a small target detection radius – Oh, am I making this guy weak on purpose? Exactly! This will be used as a pretty much lvl 1 creep that you can easily kill to heal yourself and it won’t be required to be eliminated in order to progress the level. I thought this could be much better than just spawning a lot of health packs you can freely pick.
[*] Added a default inventory when you first start the game – Melany’s Pigtails + Lab Girl’s outfit + M4 Rifle (+ A UI Update) – This will prepare it for v0.3 when you will be able to customize each individual item from your inventory and take it off.
[*] Pressing the “I” key opens the inventory rather than pressing ESC and then opening it manually.
[*] Updated the controller’s physics to be more consistent – should solve some going through walls issues while dashing.
[*] Changes to the romance scenes ability UI.
[/list]

 Week 4:
[list]
[*] Enemies can drop items that heal you upon interaction.
[*] Limit the amount of enemies and enemies of the same type that can attack you concurrently.
[*] Default crosshair, which is always visible even if you don’t aim with a gun. You can turn it off from the game settings, if you don’t want to see it.
[*] The player camera was moved to the right to give you a better view and going from non-ADS to ADS mode easier.
[*] Changes to lvl 1 in the Campaign's combat during quest 'Find the Lead' - added health pickups, decreased the amount of enemies on wave 3 and spawned more lower health creeps that drop health pickups when killed.
[/list]

notes.title: New Romance Scene and Customizable Equipment (v0.2 ON THE WAY!)
notes.content:
I’ve spent the last few days working on the equipment system (video at the bottom), making its way in v0.2 and below I’m going to give you some details.
When you purchase a skin with in-game currency, you will get main 4 items, all of which containing a collection of things your Soma can wear:

[list]
[*] Head gear – hairstyle, glasses and so on..
[*] Body gear – shirts, pants, socks, gloves and so on..
[*] Lingerie.
[*] Accessories – earrings, rings, chokers..
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/0a5ddace864598e5472ea21e90a2e056254e6fc3.png[/img]
My decision was to make a skin system similar to games like LoL or hero shooters, but make it better, by giving you these main parts listed above, which relate to a skin, so you can mix the “Head gear” from SkinA with “Body gear” of SkinB and Accessories of SkinC. Even more than that, you can unequip each individual part of the skin, for example the gloves and boots can be unequipped while the rest of the skin stays on. Imagine how awesome it would be if in hero shooters, you could mix and match, using a hairstyle from one favorite skin while wearing the outfit from another, well in Sombionic you could do that.
I’d say this is a system, that fits Sombionic’s scope and is an extension of the skin system you see in most games. The reason why I didn’t want to go with an RPG style inventory is because when you design each new shirt you have to worry if it’s going to overextend and clip into each of the pants models you have in-game (what if they are 200..).
Now both systems have downsides, the one I’ve decided to go with requires me to design a whole outfit + hairstyle before bringing it to the in-game shop, so a total of minimum 4 items (hairstyle, shirt, pants, boots), while in the RPG style inventory, I can just put gloves in the store and do the rest as time goes on.
In the next update, I will bring customization to each item, you’ll be able to change textures, colors and other shader-related things for each item and even turn-off certain parts of the items – for example the jacket, which is a part of the Lab-Girl skin has “top” and “bottom” part  and you’ll be able to make each part invisible (see below).

There’s a new h-scene that’s a work in progress...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/0607eea3fe2f55dbb5ece3f7ae8b27702f2e951f.png[/img]
 I’m hoping to get it done in the next few days and the only problem is that one of the characters is using a different scale in-engine (scaled up after rigging) while I’ve been told to never change scales after rigging and now I’m experiencing a lot of difficulties transferring the animation, my plan now is to unbind the bones, scale up the character, bind again and import the fresh scaled model in-engine.

As I’m wrapping things for the v0.2 demo, I want to tell you about the other small things I had to update in the meantime.
[list]
[*] Enemies can drop items that heal you upon interaction.
[*] Limit the amount of enemies and enemies of the same type that can attack you concurrently.
[*] Default crosshair, which is always visible even if you don’t aim with a gun. You can turn it off from the game settings, if you don’t want to see it.
[*] The player camera was moved to the right to give you a better view and going from non-ADS to ADS mode easier.
[/list]

notes.title: The AI can romance you during combat!
notes.content:
Do you think AI can have feelings? Is it possible for AI to experience romance and be part of a relationship? I’m neither a Silicon Valley techbro nor a dating coach, so I’ve got no idea, but if you're curious about how AI can romance you in Sombionic, keep reading!

So far, it was only possible for you – the player to start erotic scenes with other characters, now the AI can do that too.

Here’s a brief overview of how it works, step by step so you know what actions are executed in order.

[list]
[*] When AI hits you, it rolls a dice if it should romance you or not, there’s a random percentage each time from a range (let’s say 20 – 40 percent), in both cases a cooldown is applied, so it cannot request a new scene right after that.
[*] We also make sure that the AI can request animations and you haven’t turned that off from the settings of the game (more explanation and an image below).
[*] Then we wait a bunch of seconds to stack more requests if other enemies are also hitting you or hitting your friendly characters.
[*] All of the requests are sent to 1 system that processes them.
[*] First, it picks a scene with the player, then will try to pick a scene amongst other AI agents (currently the latter is not implemented, but for the team deathmatch game mode and boss war it will be, so AI characters can start scenes amongst each other without the player.)
[*] Each AI that can romance you has a priority, weaker ones will start at 1 while bosses will have a higher number. The system picks the one with highest priority and requests to start it. For example if you get hit by a boss and a simple creep at the same time, the system will choose the scene with the boss. Those priorities can change during gameplay, for example in certain areas.
[*] You have a number of seconds to press a key and decline the romance request, if you do that a cooldown is applied, so the AI cannot start a scene right away.
[*] If you don’t decline, an erotic scene is started.
[*] When the scene ends a cooldown is applied, so that AI has to wait before requesting another scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/7ee4e6082d23317fac9fe62d18ef3190e46ff854.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Edge cases.
[/b]This is what always takes the most time, because I have to think about all of the things that could go wrong. For example, what happens if a character wants to romance you, but you are already in an erotic animation? What if you are dead or very far away? In such cases, every character keeps a list of others who want to romance it and if something like that happens, all of them get notified - “I’m out of this, don’t bother me”.

[b]UI Module
[/b]What if you don’t like a certain character and you never want to see erotic scenes with it?
Go to the settings and you can turn off each character’s romance ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/f136e864c2d2ba772375531fbde328d9c767f7ca.png[/img]
There’s an option at the bottom of the AI section called “Show Animation Decline UI” – if you toggle it off, you won’t see that “Press X to decline” UI on the left side of the screen, but the AI will still be able to romance you during combat.
Here’s what else I did on the side: 
[list]
[*]A new AI that stays in place and attacks – it will be used for tentacles and tanky characters that are optional to kill, but drop a decent loot.
[*]A new AI with low health, low movement speed, and a small target detection radius – Oh, am I making this guy weak on purpose? Exactly! This will be used as a pretty much lvl 1 creep that you can easily kill to heal yourself and it won’t be required to be eliminated in order to progress the level. I thought this could be much better than just spawning a lot of health packs you can freely pick.
[*]Added a default inventory when you first start the game – Melany’s Pigtails + Lab Girl’s outfit + M4 Rifle (+ A UI Update) – This will prepare it for v0.3 when you will be able to customize each individual item from your inventory and take it off. 
[*]Pressing the “I” key opens the inventory rather than pressing ESC and then opening it manually 
[*]Updated the controller’s physics to be more consistent – should solve some going through walls issues while dashing
[/list]

notes.title: THANK YOU FOR THE WISHLISTS! +DEV UPDATE
notes.content:
Thank you all who wishlisted Sombionic on Steam, if you still haven’t done it, click the button on the Steam page! There will be a free beta with limited and those who wishlist will get notified to sign up when it’s ready.

I have been solo working on this game for quite some time and I had doubts about some of the systems, if they will be easy to understand and interact with. Last week there were quite a few of you testing the demo of the first level and giving me feedback, which had me change things, add features to make the game easier to play and balance some of the quests and enemies.

Here is what I have done since then:

[list]
[*] Skippable prologue (while playing it and from the menu).
[*] Checkpoints are now working correctly.
[*] Hold ‘E’ is converted to just Press ‘E’ in most of the cases, where it’s still hold, you will see a UI popup letting you know you should hold.
[*] The shooting range tutorial has only 1 task, which is a combination of the static & dynamic targets.
[*] The shooting targets count for the tutorial is reduced from 30 to 10 (but its repeatable if you wish).
[*] Enemy difficulty is toned down during the first level.
[*] If you break the collision in the cave level you won't fall down, but be teleported inside the cave again.
[*] Saving your progress after the level has been completed is fully working.
[*] Fixed full screen and windowed mode not switching.
[*] Small localization errors were fixed.
[*] Fixed small bugs in the UI.
[/list]
The game saves automatically when you reach a checkpoint (I can add some interactable checkpoints as well) and there are 4 checkpoint files per level and once you reach the last fourth one, it will go back to the first and save your progress there. This is how it looks like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013833/c9e4c1e72f317c759f7f308ad8e4f2eaff5c1c64.png[/img]

This is what kind of data is saved inside a checkpoint file:

[list]
[*] Quest progress
[*] Inventories
[*] Dialogues progress (mainly variable changes if any)
[*] Location
[*] Date & Time
[/list]
I’m also considering saving the health, but for now this won’t be the case.
Oh and lastly, I’m building a news station from where I will be broadcasting the news every 10 days, but more on that later!
